title: cosmetics: some classes are not translatable
body:
It is not possible to translate following strings in `Treatments.java`

* `JoH.static_toast_long("Refusing to create a treatement more than 1 hours in the future!");`
* `JoH.scheduleNotification(context, "Treatment Reminder"`
* `return "Treatment";`

Most important is the word `Treatment` which is visible when treatment is edited.
